tasks.label: dev:ui+api
tasks.command: $apiDir = "c:\Users\Landon F\school\csci331-Web-Development\mscs-api"; $uiDir = "c:\Users\Landon F\school\csci331-Web-Development\mscs-ui"; function IsPortOpen([int]$p){ (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port $p -WarningAction SilentlyContinue).TcpTestSucceeded }; $started = @(); if (-not (IsPortOpen 5000)) { if (Get-Job -Name mscs_api -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Stop-Job mscs_api; Remove-Job mscs_api }; Start-Job -Name mscs_api -ScriptBlock { param($dir) Push-Location $dir; $env:PORT="5000"; npm run dev } -ArgumentList $apiDir; $started += 'mscs_api' } else { Write-Host "API already listening on 5000" }; if (-not (IsPortOpen 3000)) { if (Get-Job -Name mscs_ui -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Stop-Job mscs_ui; Remove-Job mscs_ui }; Start-Job -Name mscs_ui -ScriptBlock { param($dir) Push-Location $dir; npm run dev } -ArgumentList $uiDir; $started += 'mscs_ui' } else { Write-Host "UI already listening on 3000" }; if ($started.Count -gt 0) { Write-Host ("Started: {0}" -f ($started -join ', ')); Wait-Job -Name $started } else { Write-Host "UI/API already running"; while ($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 300 } }
